National Herald, Chinese-American Daily News :-

"NO CLUES FOUND IN INVESTIGATION OF ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION
OF MR. R.V. YORKE WHO STATES HE SAW THE CAPTURE OF A GUNMAN
BY JAPANESE SOLDIER ; PEOPLE BELIEVE CASE WILL REMAIN AN
UNSOLVED MYSTERY"

According to news from foreign circles,
Japanese authorities, through a spokesman, are maintaining
that they know nothing about the arrest other than what they
had read in the "China Press." Yesterday, Deputy
Commissioner Reginald W. Yorke reiterated that he saw an
oriental gunman captured by a uniformed Japanese gendarme
after the unsuccessful attempt on his life last Friday
morning. Thus, the motive of the attempt and the
whereabouts of the gunman are shrouded in mystery.
Reliable quarters affirm that, according
to an eye-witness, an oriental gunman was actually captured
at the scene of the attempted assassination but was released
by the Police Station a few minutes afterwards. The eye-
witness further stated that he followed the gunman and two
gendarmes and on turning the corner of a road he noticed
the three men hold a short conversation, after which the
gunman was released and made a hurried retreat. The eye-
witness stated that he could not say whether the oriental
gunman was a Chinese or a Japanese.
Although both the Shanghai Municipal
Police and the Japanese authorities state that investigations
are still in progress, well-informed quarters believe that
this case will become another unsolved mystery. They
point out that the gunmen who attacked Acting Commissioner
Blanchet of the French Police are still at large, while the
attempted assassination of Mr. Godfrey Phillips, Secretary
and Commissioner-General of the Shanghai Municipal Council,
is still unsolved.

可靠方面证实，据一名目击者称，一名东方裔持枪歹徒确实在未遂暗杀现场被抓获，但几分钟后被警察局释放。该目击者进一步陈述，他跟随该持枪歹徒和两名宪兵，在转过一个路口时，注意到这三名男子进行了简短交谈，随后持枪歹徒被释放并匆忙逃离。该目击者表示，他无法断定该东方裔持枪歹徒是中国人还是日本人。
尽管上海公共租界工部局警务处和日本当局均表示调查仍在进行中，但消息灵通人士认为，此案将成为另一桩未解之谜。他们指出，袭击法国警察署代理总监布朗谢（Blanchet）的枪手仍然在逃，而针对上海公共租界工部局秘书兼总办戈弗雷·菲利普斯（Godfrey Phillips）先生的未遂暗杀案也尚未侦破。

At 9.20 a.m. 6-9-40 a telephone message was
received at Bubbling Well Station from Chinese
Police Watchman No.1617, reporting that armed
gangsters had just attacked Mr. R.F. Yorke,
Deputy Commissioner of Police, whilst he was
leaving his home at lane 749, House No. 7, Yu
Yuen Road.

On receipt of above information the Station
Alarm was rung, and all available men under Chief
Inspector MacFarlane were in the act of proceeding
to the location in question, when Mr. Yorke
arrived at Bubbling Well Station riding in his
m/car, licence no.8474, driven by Police Chauffeur
Waung Sui Ling (    ), Permit No.5.

Mr. Yorke explained that he was uninjured
and that his would-be-assassins had made good
their escape West along Yu Yuen Road, where he
had seen the 1st described overload, being arrest-
ed by a member of the Japanese Gendarmerie.

On receipt of this information D.S.I.
Goloubkoff in company of D.S.696 Hagamme were
immediately dispatched to the scene of the crime,
for purpose of, if possible, collecting witnesses
and any other available evidence.

In the meantime the undersigned interviewed
Mr. Yorke and obtained from him the following
information:-

It would appear that for the past three or
four days Mr. Yorke has been informed by his
pages.zh:
1940年9月6日上午9:20，静安寺巡捕房接到中国警员第1617号的电话报告，称武装匪徒刚刚袭击了警务处副总监 R.F. 约克先生，当时他正离开位于愚园路7号749弄的住所。

收到上述信息后，巡捕房拉响警报，在麦克法兰（MacFarlane）总督察指挥下的所有可用警力正准备前往事发地点，此时约克先生乘坐其机动车（车牌号8474）抵达静安寺巡捕房，司机为警务处 chauffeur 王水林（Waung Sui Ling）（    ），许可证号5。

约克先生解释说他未受伤，且企图暗杀他的人已沿愚园路向西成功逃脱，在那里他看到前述第一名超载人员（原文如此，疑为overlooked或指代前文描述之人，此处照实译出或理解为“前述第一人”）被一名日本宪兵队成员逮捕。

收到此信息后，副主管警官戈卢布科夫（Goloubkoff）与侦探警员第696号哈加姆（Hagamme）立即被派往犯罪现场，目的是尽可能收集证人证言及其他可用证据。

与此同时，签署人约谈了约克先生，并从他那里获得了以下信息：-

看来在过去三四天里，约克先生已被告知他的

pages.en:
2020/40(WW)

1 (Sheet 3)

suspicious characters loitering in the land leading
to his house and as a result has taken all necessary
precautions.

At approximately 8.30 a.m. 6-9-40 Mr. Yorke was
again informed of the presence of suspicious characters
in the lane and as a result of an observation make
from the window of his home saw the two described
persons walking back and forward at the entrance to
the lane.

At 9.05 a.m. 6-9-40 Mr. Yorke left his home,
which is located on the East side of Lane 749, about
35 yards South of Yu Yuen Road, and on observing the
two suspects standing on Yu Yuen Road, a few feet West
of Lane 749, he took the precaution of placing his
service pistol No.3552 into his jacket pocket.

Almost simultaneous to him boarding his m/car,
and as same moved off in a Northerly direction to-
wards Yu Yuen Road he observed the two suspects enter
the lane and come towards him. Sensing something
amiss Mr. Yorke took his pistol from his pocket and
had just loaded same when he observed the 1st
described would-be-assassin pull an automatic pistol
from under his jacket and commence firing at him.
Mr. Yorke immediately returned the fire and at the
pages.zh:
2020/40(WW)

1 (第3页)

通往其住所的弄堂里有可疑人物徘徊，因此他采取了所有必要的预防措施。

1940年9月6日上午8:30左右，约克先生再次被告知弄堂内有可疑人物出现，因此他从自家窗户进行观察，看到上述两名描述的人员在弄堂入口处来回走动。

1940年9月6日上午9:05，约克先生离开位于愚园路以南约35码、749弄东侧的住所，当他观察到两名嫌疑人站在749弄以西几英尺处的愚园路上时，他 precautionarily 将他的配枪第3552号放入夹克口袋。

几乎在他登上机动车的同时，当车辆向北朝愚园路方向驶离时，他观察到两名嫌疑人进入弄堂并向他走来。约克先生察觉到有异，从口袋中取出手枪，就在刚装上子弹时，他看到前述第一名未遂刺客从夹克下掏出一把自动手枪并开始向他射击。约克先生立即还击，并在

pages.en:
2020/40 (BW)

1 (Sheet 4)

same time his chauffeur accelerated the m/car engine.
During the ensuing gun battle Mr. Yorke observed that
both his would-be assassins were firing at him and at
the same time, were hacking through a hedge, which
runs on the West side of the lane. Arriving at Yu
Yuen Road Mr. Yorke looked through the rear window of
his car and in so doing observed the two males making
their get-away East along Yu Yuen Road, also at this
time he observed a number of the Japanese Gendarmerie
standing on the South side of the roadway approximate-
ly 30 yards West of lane 749, and as these two men
ran past this individual, he was seen by Mr. Yorke
to arrest one of them.

Mr. Yorke then instructed his chauffeur to drive
to Babbling Well Station, where on his m/car being
examined, it was found to have been hit three times
by bullets, viz:- One shot in the left hand side
front mudguard, and two in the left hand side rear
door. Further examination revealed three spent
bullets and two empty cartridge cases inside the rear
portion of the car.

These have since been forwarded to Arms
Identification Section for examination and result
will be given later.
pages.zh:
2020/40 (BW)

1 (第4页)

同时，他的司机加速机动车引擎。在随后的枪战中，约克先生观察到两名未遂刺客都在向他射击，同时正在砍穿位于弄堂西侧的一道树篱。到达愚园路后，约克先生透过汽车后窗观看，在此过程中观察到这两名男子沿愚园路向东逃跑，同时他还观察到数名日本宪兵队成员站在749弄以西约30码处的道路南侧，当这两名男子跑过其中一人身边时，约克先生看到此人逮捕了其中一人。

随后，约克先生指示司机驾车前往静安寺巡捕房，在对他的机动车进行检查时，发现车身被子弹击中三次，即：- 左前挡泥板一处，左后门两处。进一步检查发现车后部有三枚射出的子弹和两个空弹壳。

这些物品随后已被送往武器鉴定科进行检查，结果稍后公布。

Examination of Mr. Yorke's pistol revealed that
he had fired seven rounds from same, in view of which
and as the assassins must have fired at least as many
shots a message was circulated to all hospitals
enquiring for any one admitted suffering from bullet
wounds.

At 9.45 a.m. 6-9-40, D.S.I. Golosbkoff accompan-
ied by P.S. Magraine returned from the scene of crime
and reported having been unable to find any empty
cartridge cases, and to having been informed by
bystanders that same had been picked up by Chinese
and taken away.

The above officers were successful in locating
the following witnesses, who on being questioned,
gave the following account of what they had seen:-
----------------------------------------
Kau Yuin An (高永安), age 17, native of Yangchow,
s/shoe-maker, residing at No.2 Sung Ka Zah (沈家宅)
Village, off Yu Yuen Road, and operating a stall at
the entrance of Lane 749 Yu Yuen Road, states that
for about one week past he has observed the two
described persons loitering in the vicinity of Lane
749 Yu Yuen Road and that as a rule they used to
arrive around 7 a.m. and remain until he left at 7 p.m.
pages.zh:
0000/40 (RW)
! (第5页)

对约克先生手枪的检查显示，
他从中发射了七发子弹，鉴于此，
且刺客至少也发射了同样数量的子弹，
遂向所有医院发出通告，
查询是否有任何因枪伤入院的人员。

1940年9月6日上午9:45，副主管警官戈洛布斯科夫（Golosbkoff）在警佐马格雷恩（Magraine）陪同下从犯罪现场返回，报告称未能找到任何空弹壳，并被告知旁观者称弹壳已被中国人捡起并带走。

上述警官成功找到了以下证人，经询问，他们就其所见提供了如下陈述：-
----------------------------------------
高永安（Kau Yuin An），17岁，扬州人，职业修鞋匠，居住于愚园路旁沈家宅村2号，并在愚园路749弄入口处经营一个摊位，他表示在过去一周左右，他观察到上述两名描述的人员在愚园路749弄附近徘徊，通常他们在早上7点左右到达，并一直停留到他晚上7点离开。

pages.en:
2020/40(Ⅲ)
1 (Sheet 6)

During the day they would relieve one another presumably for purpose of taking food, but that always one of them remained in the vicinity. On occasions both himself and a Chinese Police Watchman No.1617 have conversed with them and on each occasion these two men have done so in Shanghai dialect, but irrespective of this, C.P.W.1617 has often expressed the belief that they were Koreans.

Continuing, this witness states how at approximately 9 a.m. 6-9-40, whilst he was busily engaged at his work at the entrance to lane 749, he heard several shots being fired quite close to him and on looking up he observed the two described persons, both armed with automatic pistols firing at Mr. Yorke who was riding in his m/car and that at this time Mr. Yorke returned the fire causing the two men to decamp West on Yu Yuen Road towards Edinburgh Road and that after the 1st described person had gone about 30 yards he was accosted by a Japanese Gendarmarie. However this man spoke to the Japanese, who immediately released hold of him and together, both walked away quickly in the direction of Edinburgh Road.

Chinese Police Watchman No.1617 named Hsu Feng Hua (徐文華), age 39, native of Hunan, employed gnd residing
pages.zh:
2020/40(Ⅲ)
1 (第6页)

白天他们会轮流休息， presumably 为了吃饭，但总是有一人留在附近。有时他自己和中国警员第1617号曾与他们交谈，每次这两人都用上海话交流，但尽管如此，中国警员第1617号经常表示相信他们是朝鲜人。

接着，这位证人陈述，1940年9月6日上午9点左右，当他正在749弄入口处忙于工作时，听到附近几声枪响，抬头一看，观察到上述两名描述的人员，均持有自动手枪，向乘坐机动车的约克先生射击，此时约克先生还击，导致这两名男子沿愚园路向西朝爱丁堡路方向逃窜，前述第一名描述的人在跑了约30码后，被一名日本宪兵拦下。然而，此人与日本人交谈后，日本人立即松手，两人一起迅速朝爱丁堡路方向走去。

中国警员第1617号，名为徐文华（Hsu Feng Hua），39岁，湖南人，受雇并居住

pages.en:
2020/40 (HW)

1 (Sheet 7)

at Lane 750 Yu Yuen Road, on being questioned, stated
that since the 2nd or 3rd of September 1940, he has
seen the two described persons loitering in the
vicinity of Lane 749 and that on one occasion whilst
he was discussing them with the previous witness he
was approached by one of them, who in Shanghai dialect,
enquired of them what they were talking about.
Although on several other occasion these two men spoke
to him, he is of the opinion that they are either
Koreans or Japanese, inasmuch that their conversations
have always been limited to passing the time of day
and other trivial remarks, also their general appear-
ance have suggested such.

Continuing this witness explains how at approxi-
mately 9 a.m. 6-9-40, whilst he was patrolling inside
Lane 750 Yu Yuen Road, which is directly opposite to
Lane 749, he heard several shots being fired and on
running from the lane he was informed by bystanders
that some persons had attempted to assassinate a
foreigner, also seeing m/car 8674 nearby. He
immediately returned inside Lane 750, proceeded to
House No.18, and used the telephone in ringing
Nanking Wall Station.
pages.zh:
2020/40 (HW)

1 (第7页)

于愚园路750弄，在接受询问时表示，
自1940年9月2日或3日以来，他一直看到
上述两名描述的人员在749弄附近徘徊，
有一次，当他与前一位证人讨论他们时，
其中一人走近，用上海话询问
他们在谈论什么。
虽然这两人在其他几次场合也与他交谈，
但他认为他们要么是朝鲜人，要么是日本人，
因为他们的谈话仅限于寒暄
和其他琐碎言论，而且他们的外貌也暗示了这一点。

接着，这位证人解释，1940年9月6日上午9点左右，
当他在正对749弄的愚园路750弄内巡逻时，
听到几声枪响，跑出弄堂后，
他从旁观者处得知有人企图暗杀一名外国人，
并看到附近有车牌号为8674的机动车。
他立即返回750弄内，前往18号房屋，
并使用电话致电南京路巡捕房。

pages.en:
2020/40 (15)

1 (Sheet 3)

This witness did not actually witness the shooting
nor did he see the men involved, but from the general
description of the men given he identified them as the
two men he had previously seen loitering in that
vicinity.

As can be seen from the aforegoing statements
there appears to be no doubt as to the arrest of one
of the would-be-assassins by a member of the Japanese
Gendarmerie, also it would appear that the person so
arrested did speak the Japanese language inasmuch as,
that he was seen to talk to the Gendarmerie member,
who, according to witnesses immediately released hold
of him and together walked away in the direction of
Edinburgh Road.

In view of above D.S. Magennis was requested to
visit Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters, 94 Junefield
Road, and request any information concerning the arrest
of one of these men.

This he did at 11 a.m. 6-3-40 and was informed
that no such arrest had been made and that if such had
been the case they would have known immediately
inasmuch as that their Branch Office at 864 Yu Yuan
Road, which is located nearby to Lane 709 would have
undoubtedly had knowledge of the occurrence. This
pages.zh:
2020/40 (15)

1（第3页）

该证人并未亲眼目睹枪击过程，也未看清涉案人员，但根据对这些人的一般描述，他指认出这两人即是他此前在该区域附近游荡时曾见过的两人。

从上述陈述可以看出，其中一名企图行刺者被一名日本宪兵逮捕一事似乎毫无疑问；此外，被捕者似乎会讲日语，因为据目击者称，有人看见他与该宪兵交谈，随后该宪兵立即松手释放了他，两人一同朝爱丁堡路（Edinburgh Road）方向走去。

鉴于上述情况，已请警探长马金尼斯（D.S. Magennis）前往位于俊菲尔德路94号（Junefield Road, 94）的日本宪兵司令部，索取有关逮捕其中一名男子的任何信息。

他于1940年3月6日上午11时照办，并获告知并未发生此类逮捕事件；且若确有此事，他们应会立即知晓，因为其位于愚园路864号的支局靠近709弄，无疑会知晓该事件。此

refutes the statements of all witnesses as made to
the undersigned, who definitely state they saw a

Kau Yuin An, age 17.
Yangchow                                      D.S.I. Yao Yuen Loong
B'well Station          6-9-1940                        -ditto-

I am a shoe-maker, having a stall placed at the entrance
of Lane 749 Yu Yuen Road, and residing at No.: Sung In Zah
Village off Yu Yuen Road.

At about 9 a.m. 6-9-40 whilst I was making shoes at my
stall, I heard several shots fired near me and at the same time
I observed two male Chinese, all wearing foreign style cloth-
ing, both armed with long barrelled pistols, firing at a
foreigner who was sitting in a motor car. The foreigner then
returned fire at the two armed men who then concealed their
pistols under their clothing and ran westward attempting to
make good their escape. At the time of their decamping, a
Japanese soldier arrested one of them, who talked something to
the Japanese soldier and the latter released hold of him but
walked away together with him west along Yu Yuen Road towards
Edinburgh Road. I recognised these two armed men as being the
men who had been loitering in the vicinity of the entrance of
Lane 749 Yu Yuen Road for about a week and sometimes they asked
me about my business, meal, etc., in Shanghai dialect. They
used to come at about 8 a.m. daily but I did not know what time
they left there because I returned home at about 7 p.m. every
day, when they were found still loitering there.

The following is a description of the two men:-

(1) Age about 26, height about 5'8", round pale face,
long black hair parted in the middle, wearing white
foreign style suit. Shanghai dialect.
(2) Age about 25, height about 5'7", medium build, long
pale face, long black hair parted in the left, with
many freckles on the face, wearing white foreign
style suit.

This is my true statement.

(Signed, cross-marked and thumb
printed).

我是一名鞋匠，摊位设在愚园路749弄口，居住在愚园路外的宋恩扎村（Sung In Zah Village，音译）某号。

1940年9月6日上午9时许，当我在摊位做鞋时，听到附近传来几声枪响，同时我看见两名中国男子，均身穿西式服装，手持长枪管手枪，向一名坐在汽车里的外国人射击。该外国人随即向两名持枪男子还击，二人遂将手枪藏入衣内，向西逃跑，企图逃脱。在他们逃窜时，一名日本士兵逮捕了其中一人，该人与日本士兵说了些什么，后者便松开了他，但两人一同沿愚园路向西朝爱丁堡路方向走去。我认出这两名持枪男子就是过去一周左右在愚园路749弄口附近游荡的人，有时他们会用上海话问我关于生意、吃饭等情况。他们通常每天上午8点左右来，但我不知道他们何时离开，因为我每天晚上7点左右回家时，发现他们仍在那里游荡。

以下是这两人的体貌特征：

(1) 年龄约26岁，身高约5英尺8英寸，圆脸，面色苍白，黑色长发中分，身穿白色西式西装。讲上海话。
(2) 年龄约25岁，身高约5英尺7英寸，中等身材，长脸，面色苍白，黑色长发左分，脸上有许多雀斑，身穿白色西式西装。

以上是我的真实陈述。

（签名，画十字并按手印）。

XXXXXX Clark Sih Chien Shih

I am C.P. .1617 employed by the S.M.P. and posted on duty at Lane 750 Yu Yuen Road.

At about 9.20 a.m. 6-9-40, when I was on duty in Lane 750 Yu Yuen Road, I heard two shots fired on the roadway. I immediately came out and saw m/car licence No.8474 parked at the entrance of Lane 749 Yu Yuen Road. At the same time I heard some bystanders tell me that a case of assassination had been taken place. I immediately returned to Lane 750, entered House No.10, where I telephoned to Bubbling Well Police Station and reported the occurrence.

After telephoning the police, I again came out of Lane 750 when I discovered that m/car 8474 had been driven away. According to some eye-witnesses told me, the two would-be-assassins, both wearing foreign style suit, had escaped west along Yu Yuen Road.

According to the descriptions given to me, I recalled that at about 7.30 a.m. on 3-9-40, when I was on duty at the entrance to Lane 750, I saw two foreign style dressed men stand on the South side of Yu Yuen Road and look at Lane 749. After about 5 minutes, they walk away, and talk with a shoe-maker. I then approached the shoe-maker and asked him what they were talking. The shoe-maker told me that they said he worked too slow. One of them then asked me as to why I should inter their business and then they walked away west along Yu Yuen Road. At about 11 a.m. 4-9-40, I again saw these two men standing outside Lane 750 Yu Yuen Road, underneath two trees and looked into Lane 749. They walked away after about five minutes. At about 4 p.m. on 5-9-40, I saw these two men walk out of Lane 749 and walk west along Yu Yuen Road. According to my point of view, they are Koreans.

This is my true statement. (Signed & cross-marked).

XXXXXX 克拉克·施健士（Clark Sih Chien Shih，音译）

我是受雇于上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的华捕1617号，派驻愚园路750弄执勤。

1940年9月6日上午9时20分许，当我在愚园路750弄执勤时，听到马路上响起两声枪响。我立即出来，看见车牌号为8474的汽车停在愚园路749弄口。同时，我听到一些旁观者告诉我发生了一起刺杀案。我立即返回750弄，进入10号房屋，打电话给静安寺捕房报告了此事。

报警后，我再次走出750弄，发现8474号汽车已驶离。据一些目击者告诉我，两名企图行刺者均身穿西式西装，已沿愚园路向西逃逸。

根据向我提供的描述，我回想起1940年9月3日上午7时30分左右，当我在750弄口执勤时，看见两名身穿西式服装的男子站在愚园路南侧，注视着749弄。大约5分钟后，他们走开，并与一名鞋匠交谈。于是我走近鞋匠，询问他们在谈什么。鞋匠告诉我，他们说他的活儿干得太慢。其中一人随后质问我为何干涉他们的业务，然后他们沿愚园路向西走去。1940年9月4日上午11时许，我再次看见这两人站在愚园路750弄外两棵树下，向749弄内张望。大约五分钟后他们离开。1940年9月5日下午4时许，我看见这两人从749弄走出，沿愚园路向西走去。依我看，他们是朝鲜人。

以上是我的真实陈述。（签名并画十字）。

September 7, 1940.

Journal de Shanghai:-

"DEPUTY COMMISSIONER YORKE OF S.M.P. SHOT AT WITH
REVOLVER: FIRES SEVEN SHOTS AT ASSAILANTS ONE OF
WHOM IS ARRESTED BY A JAPANESE GENDARME"

An attempt to assassinate Mr. Yorke, Deputy
Commissioner of the Shanghai Municipal Police, was made by
two desperadoes yesterday morning in a lane off Yu Yuen Road.
Mr. Yorke returned the fire. The exchange of shots had
no result.
Describing the attack, Mr. Yorke stated that having
boarded his motor car in front of his house, he gave orders
to his chauffeur to drive into town. When the car had gone
about 20 metres from the place where the lane joins Yu Yuen
Road, Mr. Yorke noticed in the middle of the lane two Chinese
well dressed in white flannel foreign suits, who, upon seeing
the car, placed their hands in their clothing. Mr. Yorke,
who has been with the S.M.P. for 27 years, made no mistake
about the meaning of their action. He immediately picked
up his own pistol which was lying by his side and opened
fire at his assailants at the same moment that the latter
began to fire.
As the motor car was continuing on its way, Mr. Yorke's
aim was necessarily not so precise but it sufficiently upset
the assailants for their shots missed their mark. The
chauffeur succeeded in driving out of the lane which was
deserted at the time.
Mr. Yorke fired seven shots at the two men. One
of them fled towards the end of the lane, the other went
towards Yu Yuen Road where he ran into the arms of a Japanese
gendarme who seized him and disappeared with him in a
westerly direction.
Having no more cartridges, Mr. Yorke proceeded to
Bubbling Well Police Station to make a report and afterwards
he left immediately for his office at Police Headquarters.
Three bullet marks were found on the car; one in the front
mud-guard and the other two in the left-hand door. One
of the bullets after having passed through the door was
embedded in the back seat a few centimetres from the spot
where Mr. Yorke was seated.
If paid assassins are aiming high, they should
recognize that their task will be more difficult than that
of attacking poor defenceless and terrorized Chinese. It
is recalled that when Lieut. P. Blanchet, Chief of the French
Police, was attacked, he single-handed gave battle to six
assailants and succeeded in putting them to flight although
he was wounded in two places: one in the shoulder and one
in his side.

1940年9月7日。

《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）：

“上海公共租界工部局警务处副总督察约克遭左轮手枪射击：向袭击者连开七枪，其中一人被日本宪兵逮捕”

昨天上午，两名亡命之徒在愚园路的一条弄堂里企图刺杀上海公共租界工部局警务处副总督察约克先生。约克先生予以还击。双方交火未造成后果。

描述此次袭击时，约克先生表示，他在自家门前登上汽车后，吩咐司机驶入市区。当汽车驶离弄堂与愚园路交汇处约20米时，约克先生注意到弄堂中间有两名衣着考究、身穿白色法兰绒西式西装的中国男子，他们看见汽车后便将手伸入衣内。在警务处服役27年的约克先生对他们的举动含义毫不误解。他立即拿起放在身旁的手枪，在袭击者开始射击的同时向他们开火。

由于汽车仍在行进中，约克先生的瞄准必然不够精准，但这足以扰乱袭击者，致使他们的射击未能命中目标。司机成功将车驶出当时空无一人的弄堂。

约克先生向这两人开了七枪。其中一人向弄堂尽头逃去，另一人则朝愚园路方向跑去，撞进了一名日本宪兵的怀里，该宪兵抓住他并带着他向西消失。

因子弹耗尽，约克先生前往静安寺捕房报案，随后立即前往警察总局办公室。车上发现了三处弹痕：一处在前挡泥板，另两处在左侧车门。其中一颗子弹穿过车门后，嵌在后排座椅上，距离约克先生坐的位置仅几厘米。

如果职业刺客意在 targeting 高层人物，他们应当认识到，他们的任务比攻击贫穷、无助且处于恐惧中的中国人要困难得多。回想当年法国警察局局长 P. 布兰切特中尉（Lieut. P. Blanchet）遇袭时，他单枪匹马与六名袭击者搏斗，虽两处受伤（一处在肩部，一处在侧身），但仍成功将其击退。

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao, Chinese-American Daily News, National
Herald, Central China Daily News, Bing Pao :-

ATTEMPTED ASSASSINATION OF A DEPUTY COMMISSIONER OF S.M.P.

At about 9.10 a.m. yesterday a serious shooting
case took place at the entrance of Lane 749, Yu Yuen Road
in the Western District when two desperadoes attempted to
assassinate Mr. R.W. Yorke, Deputy Commissioner of the
Special Branch of the S.M.P. who lives at No. 7, Lane 749
Yu Yuen Road.

Mr. R.W. Yorke, aged 48, British subject,
is the Deputy Commissioner of the Special Branch of the
S.M.P. He has served with the Police Force for 27 years
and is much trusted by his superior officers. He is very
brave, smart and intelligent.

At about 9.10 a.m. yesterday, Mr. Yorke left
his residence in his private motor car S.M.C. licence No.8474
which was driven by a chauffeur named Wong (王). When the
motor car had just emerged from the lane, two desperadoes,
both of about 30 years of age, dressed in white flannel
foreign suits, who were evidently waiting there, drew their
Mauser pistols on observing the car and fired more than
ten shots at Mr. Yorke. Two bullets struck the left door
of his motor car, one was wedged in the door, whilst a
third penetrated the left mudguard. Mr. Yorke was not
terrified; he drew his service pistol and fired seven shots.
Nobody on either side was injured. In view of the
unfavourable situation, the desperadoes pocketed their Mauser
pistols and tried to make their escape, but one man was
arrested by Japanese Gendarmes soon afterwards and was
taken to the Gendarmes Headquarters.

A large number of Chinese and foreign detectives
and policemen were despatched to the scene by Bubbling Well
Police Station after receiving a report of the affair,
but the second desperado had already made good his escape.
Several shells were found at the place by the policemen
and were taken back to the police station for investigation.
The S.M.C. is paying close attention to this case and has
ordered the Police to make a vigorous investigation.

《申报》、《新闻报》、《中美日报》、《国民新闻报》、《华中日报》、《晶报》：

上海公共租界工部局警务处副总督察遇刺未遂

昨日上午9时10分许，西区愚园路749弄口发生一起严重枪击案，两名亡命之徒企图刺杀居住于愚园路749弄7号的上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科副总督察 R.W. 约克先生。

R.W. 约克先生，48岁，英籍，系上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科副总督察。他在警队服役27年，深受上级信任。他非常勇敢、干练且聪明。

昨日上午9时10分许，约克先生乘坐私人汽车（上海市政委员会车牌号8474）离开住所，由一名姓王（Wong）的司机驾驶。汽车刚驶出弄堂，两名显然在此等候的亡命之徒，年龄均在30岁左右，身穿白色法兰绒西式西装，见到汽车后拔出毛瑟手枪，向约克先生射击十余发。两颗子弹击中其汽车左侧车门，一颗卡在门内，第三颗穿透左侧挡泥板。约克先生并未惊慌；他拔出手枪还击七发。双方均无人受伤。鉴于形势不利，亡命之徒将毛瑟手枪放入口袋，试图逃跑，但其中一人不久后被日本宪兵逮捕，并被带往宪兵司令部。

静安寺捕房接到案情报告后，派遣大量中西探员和警察赶赴现场，但第二名亡命之徒已成功逃脱。警察在现场发现数枚弹壳，并带回警局进行调查。上海市政委员会正密切关注此案，并命令警方进行大力调查。
